mapper.select: select from zjudg_master_withdraw w left join zjudg_master m on m.master_id=w.master_id where w.withdraw_no=#{withdrawNo} limit 1
select from zjudg_master_withdraw w left join zjudg_master m on m.master_id=w.master_id where w.master_id=#{masterId} and w.withdraw_status in ('0','1') order by w.create_time desc limit 1
select from zjudg_master_withdraw w left join zjudg_master m on m.master_id=w.master_id where w.master_id=#{masterId} order by w.create_time desc
mapper.update: update zjudg_master_withdraw set withdraw_status=#{targetStatus}, audit_by=case when #{auditBy} is null then audit_by else #{auditBy} end, audit_time=case when #{auditBy} is null then audit_time else sysdate() end, audit_remark=case when #{auditRemark} is null then audit_remark else #{auditRemark} end, transfer_no=case when #{transferNo} is null then transfer_no else #{transferNo} end, pay_time=case when #{targetStatus}='2' then sysdate() else pay_time end, fail_reason=case when #{failReason} is null then fail_reason else #{failReason} end, update_time=sysdate() where withdraw_id=#{withdrawId} and withdraw_status=#{fromStatus}
